name: Same amount, split into more pieces
description: A big round portion (a ball of dough, a pizza, or a plain orange disc) in the middle of a clean background. Cut lines draw themselves from the centre to split it into the first number of pieces with a label like '8 ROTI', then the lines swing and it is re-split into the second number ('10 ROTI') while a big '=' shows the total never changed; a small title sits above and a short note below.
use_when: The same total divided differently: 'it's the same dough, just more rotis', slicing a pizza into more pieces, the same budget split more ways, 'same calories, smaller portions'.

first_label.help: label for the first split, e.g. '8 roti'

second_label.help: label for the second split, e.g. '10 roti'

note.help: line under the portion, e.g. 'Pet mein same quantity'
